text: A hundred grams of cooked chickpeas, a hundred roasted: more than double the calories.
Cooked ones are sixty percent water; roasting drives most of it off.
So a hundred grams shrinks to under half, same calories, same protein.
Per hundred grams, roasted has about three hundred eighty calories and twenty grams of protein.
Snack tip: thirty grams roasted is about seventy grams cooked, around a hundred fifteen calories.
